violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw shell eggs in the 2DR prep top cooler were being stored above ready to eat hominy and cut vegetables.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL RAW FOODS NNED TO BE STORED BELOW READY TO EAT FOODS TO PREVENT THE POTENTIAL OF CROSS CONTAMINATION. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE MOVE THE RAW SHELL EGGS TO BOTTOM SHELF OF 2DR PREP COOLER.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: the ice cream scoop used to serve ice cream to customers was not being stored correctly in running water.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ICE CREAM SCOOPS NEED TO BE STORED IN RUNNING WATER IN BETWEEN USES TO FLUSH FOOD PARTICULATES OFF. PIC SAID THEY WILL TALK TO OWNER ABOUT GETTING THIS FIXED BEFORE NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer BUTTER containers were observed reused for the storage of multiple food items in facility.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT BUTTER CONTAINERS ARE NOT ALLOWED TO BE REUSED TO STORE FOODS ONCE THE BUTER IS GONE. EHS TOLD PIC THAT WITHIN THE NEXT 6MONTHS, ALL BUTTER CONTAINERS NEED TO BE THROWN AWAY AND TO NOT BE REUSED. EHS WILL CONFIRM AT NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.
